name: AuthType
label: Auth Type
description: Select the authentication method to use with Twilio: either Auth Token or API Key.

name: AccountSid
label: Account SID
description: Your Twilio Account SID. Required for both authentication methods.

name: ApiKeySid
label: API Key SID
description: Your Twilio API Key SID. Used when authenticating with API Key.

name: ApiKeySecret
label: API Key Secret
description: Your Twilio API Key Secret. Used when authenticating with API Key.

name: AuthToken
label: Auth Token
description: Your Twilio Auth Token. Used when authenticating with Account SID + Auth Token.
